keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Austin FC 0, Portland Timbers 1. Ariel Lassiter (Portland Timbers) left footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Vincent Janssen.
Delay in match because of an injury James Pantemis (Portland Timbers).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Austin FC 0, Portland Timbers 1.
Substitution, Portland Timbers. Cole Bassett replaces Eric Izoita.
Second Half begins Austin FC 0, Portland Timbers 1.
Micah Burton (Austin FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Austin FC. Przemyslaw Placheta replaces Oleksandr Svatok.
Goal! Austin FC 0, Portland Timbers 2. Kristoffer Velde (Portland Timbers) right footed shot from outside the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Ian Smith.
Substitution, Austin FC. Myrto Uzuni replaces Micah Burton.
Substitution, Austin FC. Brendan Hines-Ike replaces Mikkel Desler.
Substitution, Portland Timbers. Jimer Fory replaces Ian Smith.
Substitution, Portland Timbers. Alexander Aravena replaces Vincent Janssen.
Substitution, Portland Timbers. Omir Fernandez replaces Ariel Lassiter.
Delay in match (Austin FC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Austin FC. Besard Sabovic replaces Jorge Alastuey.
Substitution, Portland Timbers. Diego Chará replaces Kristoffer Velde.
Second Half ends, Austin FC 0, Portland Timbers 2.
